name: Orbital Drift
objective: Pick a hull (CubeSat, Dart, Harbour Station), then hold to expand orbit and release to fall back. Chain stardust combos across risk zones and survive 4 escalating waves.
controls: Hold SPACE / mouse / touch to expand orbit, release to contract. Press 1/2/3 or click a hangar card to select CubeSat/Dart/Station. M mutes. P or Esc pauses.
flow: hangar (menu) -> playing -> paused -> playing | game_over (score) -> hangar. Re-launch replays the same hull; Hangar returns to ship select.
win_condition: Survive as long as possible and reach the highest distance or score.
avoid: Colliding with asteroids, stalkers, weavers, darters, splitters, comets, or other orbital bodies.
tips: CubeSat scores +25% but dies fast; Station tanks 150 hull but is huge and slow. Graze debris edges for combo time. Look for a Start or Play button on the menu. After game_over, a Re-launch button appears.
